content: Colab restart-aware notebook pattern: (1) pip install cells run first, (2) call os.kill(os.getpid(), 9) after pip installs to restart kernel (or use IPython.core.display.display with a JS snippet, or just tell user to restart manually with a loud markdown cell). After restart, Colab re-runs from top — so all pip install cells need to be idempotent. Common pattern: check if package installed with importlib.util.find_spec('pkg') and skip if found. However for packages that need import order (MUJOCO_GL), ALL cells must run in order top-to-bottom after restart. Best practice: one INSTALL BLOCK cell, then a RESTART STOP cell with clear instructions, then all logic cells below.
